content.title: 过去分词 vs 现在分词(done vs doing)速查
content.intro: 核心一句话:现在分词(doing)= 主动 / 进行;过去分词(done)= 被动 / 完成。判断时只看分词与它的逻辑主语(被修饰名词 / 句子主语 / 宾语)是'发出动作'还是'承受动作'。

rows: the train heading west(火车主动行驶)
the road covered with snow(路被雪覆盖)
Seeing the view, she smiled(她主动看)
Seen from the hill, the lake looks blue(湖被看)
I saw him crossing the street(他主动过街)
I had my ticket checked(票被检查)

specialRules.rule: 不及物动词没有被动,'已完成'用过去分词作定语
specialRules.mark: fallen leaves 落叶 / the risen sun 升起的太阳

specialRules.rule: fall/rise/flow 等是主动进行时用 -ing
specialRules.mark: falling leaves 正在落的叶 / rising mist 升起的雾

specialRules.rule: have / get + sth + done = '让某事被做'(被动完成)
specialRules.mark: have my photos printed 把照片冲印好

specialRules.rule: see/hear/find/watch + sb + doing(在做)/ done(被做完)
specialRules.mark: saw him crossing / found the window broken

why: 分词没有自己的主语,它的逻辑主语就是被修饰的名词或句子主语;主语'发出'动作就主动(doing),主语'承受'动作就被动(done)——所以一切判断都归到主动还是被动这一条。
gaokaoPoints: 语法填空高频:给出动词原形,要你按主动/被动填 -ing 或 -ed(如 ___ from the hill, the lake … → Seen)。
区分 fallen/falling、covered/covering:看动作是'已完成/被动'还是'正在进行/主动'。
have sth done 与 see sb doing/done 的宾补辨析。

examVsReal.exam: Seen from the plane, the city looked small.(考试/书面)
examVsReal.real: When you see it from the plane, the city looks small.
examVsReal.note: 考试爱考分词作状语;口语里常直接用从句说清楚。

examVsReal.exam: I had my ticket checked.(考试 have sth done)
examVsReal.real: Someone checked my ticket. / They checked my ticket.
examVsReal.note: 考试用 have sth done 强调'被做';口语常直接用主动句。
